summary: Animated ads service scores 0.99x (below median). Reels lose 77% viewers in first 3 seconds — hook fails. Instagram bio violates rules: names niches (hotels, cafes, gyms, homestays), region (Himachal), promises 24‑hr delivery, offers free site check outside website posts.
guidance:
- Hook style: rotate to **question** (1.53x) or **comparison** (1.39x); avoid curiosity (0.75x, n=1).
- Angle: use **mistake** framing (1.35x); avoid how_to (0.5x) and question angles (0.48x).
- Visual: try **bright-desk** (1.41x) or **silhouette** (1.29x); drop network style (0.39x).
- Stop repeating "AI vs manual" contrast hooks — used 3× in last 14 days.
- Posts must read like a developer sharing real work, never an ad. No demos, no free audits, no niche targeting.

instructions.research: Find 2–3 real Indian small-business pain points about video ad costs (e.g. cafe owner can't afford shoot, gym needs daily story ads, D2C brand needs product motion). Cite generic sources, no client names.
instructions.analysis: Compare last 3 animated_ads posts (myth, question, contrast hooks) — note which hook style got most saves/shares per reach. Feed that into today's hook choice.
instructions.writer: Write a single carousel post (3–4 slides) using a **question** hook: "What if your next Instagram ad cost less than a coffee and took minutes, not days?" Show the problem (budget, time, skill) and the AI-animated-ad workflow in general terms. End with "Pay after approval — DM to discuss fit." No demo offer.
instructions.image: Create a bright-desk style carousel: slide 1 hook text on clean desk background; slide 2 simple 3-step workflow icons (script → AI animate → upload); slide 3 price note placeholder; slide 4 CTA. No client logos, no screenshots of unlisted work.
instructions.video: Skip video today — reel skip rate 77% shows hook failure. Focus on carousel for higher save rate.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to: "AI chatbots, animated ads, lead lists & websites for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice." Remove niches, region, timeframes, free offers.
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts by Indian freelancers/agencies discussing client acquisition or video marketing — add value, don't pitch.
Reply to any story mentions or tags from collaborators (editorxyz_official, shiven_xyz) to keep network warm.
